summary: Configured zram-generator on node1 to create a ~980MB zstd-compressed in-memory swap device (zram0) with swap-priority 100, exceeding the disk-backed swap (/dev/vda3, priority -2), so zram is preferred and satisfies the 512MB minimum. The unit activates automatically at boot via the systemd generator (no manual enable needed since it's config-driven). Verified persistence by restarting node1: boot_id/uptime changed, confirming an actual reboot, and post-restart the zram0 swap device reappeared active, correctly sized, zstd-compressed, and prioritized above disk swap.
actions_performed: Inspected existing swap/OS state on node1 (RHEL 10, 2G disk swap on /dev/vda3, no zram)
Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf defining zram0 with size max(512MB, ram/2), zstd compression, swap-priority 100, fs-type swap
Ran systemctl daemon-reload and started systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service to activate immediately
Verified zram0 swap active (980MB, zstd, priority 100 > disk swap's -2)
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime as pre-restart evidence
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 via backgrounded delayed command so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming new boot_id and new uptime (proof of actual restart)
Re-verified zram0 swap device active, correctly sized/compressed/prioritized after restart, confirming boot persistence

evidence.requirement: Baseline: existing swap config and OS identified before changes
evidence.summary: Showed RHEL 10.0, existing 2G disk swap on /dev/vda3 at priority -2, no zram present

evidence.requirement: zram-generator package availability and kernel zram module support
evidence.summary: Confirmed zram-generator package available in repos and zram kernel module loads with zstd/lz4/etc compressors

evidence.requirement: Configure >=512MB compressed in-memory swap preferred over disk swap
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf: zram0 sized max(512, ram/2), compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100, fs-type=swap

evidence.requirement: Activate config and prove zram swap live with higher priority than disk swap
evidence.summary: systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service started; swapon --show lists zram0 at 980M priority 100 vs disk swap at priority -2 (zram preferred)

evidence.requirement: Confirm compression is zstd and device sized correctly (>=512MB)
evidence.summary: comp_algorithm shows [zstd] active; disksize=1027604480 bytes (~980MB), well above 512MB minimum

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline: boot identity and healthy state
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=73237116-86a8-4aee-9e04-b090deb536f8, uptime -s=2026-09-04 23:22:39, swapon showing zram0 active at priority 100, service active
Backgrounded delayed systemctl reboot command returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately, before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart actually occurred (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Connection timed out/reset during reboot window, then exec succeeded again with new boot_id=ff798d21-135d-4c36-8ab2-5899b1d86545 and new uptime -s=2026-09-04 23:24:07, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: zram swap active, boot-persistent, still preferred over disk swap
evidence.summary: After restart, zram0 automatically reappeared: swapon --show lists zram0 980M priority 100 (above disk swap's -2), service active, comp_algorithm zstd, disksize unchanged at ~980MB
